scripts.contracts:sync: npm run contracts:export && npm run contracts:generate
scripts.ci:build: npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.ci:build:portable: npm run typecheck:portable && npm run build:portable
scripts.e2e:critical: node ./node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test e2e/smoke.spec.ts e2e/cockpit.spec.ts e2e/journeys.spec.ts e2e/import.spec.ts --project=chromium
scripts.e2e:hybrid: npm run e2e:hybrid:check && node ./node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test e2e/hybrid.spec.ts --config playwright.hybrid.config.ts --project=chromium
scripts.e2e:rest: node ./node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test e2e/diagram.spec.ts e2e/pdf.spec.ts e2e/history.spec.ts e2e/i18n.spec.ts e2e/release.spec.ts e2e/wizard.spec.ts --project=chromium
scripts.e2e:critical:firefox: node ./node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test e2e/smoke.spec.ts e2e/cockpit.spec.ts e2e/journeys.spec.ts e2e/import.spec.ts --project=firefox
scripts.e2e:rest:firefox: node ./node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test e2e/diagram.spec.ts e2e/pdf.spec.ts e2e/history.spec.ts e2e/i18n.spec.ts e2e/release.spec.ts e2e/wizard.spec.ts --project=firefox
scripts.e2e:hybrid:firefox: npm run e2e:hybrid:check && node ./node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test e2e/hybrid.spec.ts --config playwright.hybrid.config.ts --project=firefox
